spans.s: BP0161 निदर्शनम् nidarśanam an Illustrative statements which explains a subject matter with the help of an example understandable to common man

SV0173 निद्रा nidrā Sleep; When the Mana (mind) & Indriya’s (sense organs) get exhausted, they withdraw themselves from the objects & the individual get sleep. Sleep is caused by Tamas, Kapha, physical and mental exertion, adventitious, as sequel to diseases and normally at night.
AF1342 निद्रा अभाव nidrā abhāva Sleeplessness
AF1344 निद्रा नाश nidrā nāśa Sleeplessness
AF1343 निद्रा भ्रंश nidrā bhraṁśa Sleeplessness
